claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The SLS rocket carried four astronauts in the Orion capsule.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission to fly around the Moon and return to Earth.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since 1972.
Artemis II tests systems for future lunar landings.
The Orion spacecraft is currently in orbit following a successful liftoff
